note: rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule id here is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py (GRAPH_RULES_IMPLEMENTED); extraction/verify_all.py fails if the two sets differ. Each rule was checked against all 23 rendered reference pages when written.

rules.rule: the PageSpec node sequence (section#variant) must match its declared template's node pattern (required/optional/slots/repeat counts).
templates with status 'pending' (T5-T17) have no contracts yet and cannot be generated against.
every implemented template starts with shell.announcement-bar, shell.navbar, shell.mega-menu, shell.mobile-drawer in that order and ends with shell.footer.
exactly one HERO-category node per page.
rules.exceptionNote: no implemented template is hero-less; pending T16/T17 must be re-checked when built (T17 has no hero on the original).

rules.rule: the HERO node is the first non-SHELL node.
a section may not appear more often than its contract's constraints.maxPerPage (observed maxima: gradient-panel 3, card-grid 2, checklist 2, closing-band 2, everything else 1).

no two adjacent nodes share the same (section, variant). Keyed on the pair, so the homepage's three alternating gradient panels (text-first/media-first/text-first) are valid; none of the 23 reference pages has an identical adjacent pair.
the last non-SHELL node should be CTA-category (true on all 23 reference pages).
at most 2 nodes with autoplaying motion (carousel.autoplay, marquee.loop) per page (the homepage has exactly 2).
a node whose contract is retrievalEligible:false (pinned in code) may not be marked retrievalEligible:true, and a content node may not be marked ineligible.
template T0 is only valid on route '/', and route '/' only on T0.
in reference mode the route must be one of the template's mapped routes (routes/routes.json).
